name: Danube Industries Limited
about: Danube Industries Limited trades in computer accessories and mobile phones in India. The company distributes tablets, laptops, CPUs, desktop systems, monitors, motherboards, storage devices, and other related accessories; entertainment systems, such as TVs, sound systems, and home assistants and theatres; appliances comprising ACs, refrigerators, washing machines, cooktops, and dishwashers; DSLR cameras and its accessories; gaming products; POS systems; networking products, including wires and cables, P&L devices, and circuits; and anti-virus, firewalls, CCTVs, VDPs, and integrated navigation suites for vessels. It also trades in beauty products; and manufactures electronics and computer peripherals. The company markets its products through its retail stores, online websites, e-commerce operators, distributors, and authorized partners. It serves customers, system integrators, enterprises, and others. The company was formerly known as Dwekam Industries Limited and changed its name to Danube Industries Limited in December 2017. Danube Industries Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
